worlds.name: Velvet Sun
worlds.subtitle: Warm soul · possibility · gratitude
worlds.musicalSignature: Warm intimate melodic leads, restrained percussion, Rhodes, round bass, lyrical details, emotionally lifted chorus, original motifs.
worlds.visualSignature: Sunlit cinematic warmth; real-world textured locations and inviting but original dreamlike portraiture. Consistent identity, never copied from an existing performer.

worlds.name: Iron Horizon
worlds.subtitle: Resilience · cinematic courage
worlds.musicalSignature: Grounded low register leads, spacious rhythm, organic cinematic strings, dynamic restraint then a clear bold anthem hook.
worlds.visualSignature: Weathered stone, expressive natural landscapes, wide heroic framing, warm horizon edge light.

worlds.name: Quiet Atlas
worlds.subtitle: Stillness · deep focus · future self
worlds.musicalSignature: Soft textured vocals or instrumentals, slow grooves, delicate room ambience, open harmonic space, gradual emotional motion.
worlds.visualSignature: Minimal architecture, evening reflections, subtle sky gradients and shadow play.

worlds.name: Electric Bloom
worlds.subtitle: Movement · energy · celebration
worlds.musicalSignature: Rhythmic Afro-influenced original pop and dance grooves, strong clean hooks, confident short lyric phrases, joyful bridges.
worlds.visualSignature: Bright natural colors, kinetic light trails, lush scenes and distinct recurring wardrobe colors.

worlds.name: Golden Current
worlds.subtitle: Harmonics · atmosphere · inner calm
worlds.musicalSignature: Spacious instrumental soundscapes and gently layered harmonics from the Timekeeper listening library. Created for musical atmosphere, not as a medical intervention.
worlds.visualSignature: Warm golden light, reflective water and subtle geometric arcs.

worlds.name: Future Signal
worlds.subtitle: Possibility · luminous pop · forward motion
worlds.musicalSignature: Expansive vocal-driven future-self pop, analog synthesizers, clear choruses and cinematic lifts. Original recordings from Frequency.
worlds.visualSignature: Sunlit architectural horizons, mirrored water and reflective blue-gold light.

worlds.name: Apex Rhythm
worlds.subtitle: Hip-hop · trap · strength
worlds.musicalSignature: Rhythmic rap-pop, bass-forward trap, punchy affirmations and confident production built for movement and action.
worlds.visualSignature: Night-city light, bold mountain forms, rhythmic motion and deep contrast.

worlds.name: Sovereign Groove
worlds.subtitle: Afrobeat · amapiano · soul
worlds.musicalSignature: Warm Afro-pop, melodic hooks, expressive groove and bright keyboard textures. These are editorial listening collections, not fictional performer credits.
worlds.visualSignature: Terracotta sunset, warm dancing lights and rhythmic tropical color.

worlds.name: Infinite Gold
worlds.subtitle: Morning light · abundance · gentle momentum
worlds.musicalSignature: Warm morning soundscapes, uplifting instrumentals and airy melodic textures from the original Timekeeper listening library.
worlds.visualSignature: Saffron gold light, open coastlines, soft luminous gradients.

worlds.name: Ether Codes
worlds.subtitle: Harmonic experiments · spacious sound
worlds.musicalSignature: Sound-art explorations of numeric frequencies with drifting tonal layers. Frequency labels describe composition rather than proven health effects.
worlds.visualSignature: Minimal generative geometry, softly glowing spectral light and subtle sound-wave halos.
